about_the_game:
A fantasy tale of magic, secrets, and love — hidden behind a delicate balance of numbers.

This is not just a game. It’s an interactive book where you juggle numbers, and every number reflects a world collapsing under the weight of its own myths.

You’ll uncover 29 chapters — a complete novel with illustrations, atmosphere, and deep characters.

The text is written entirely by hand, without the help of AI — every word born from real experience and imagination.

  • Immerse yourself in a dark kingdom filled with intrigue and secrets.

  • Features gothic ink-style illustrations.

  • Themes of inner struggle, love, and identity.

Perfect for fans of Sarah J. Maas, Leigh Bardugo, Patrick Rothfuss, and Andrzej Sapkowski.

For those who seek not action, but atmosphere. Not a battle — but depth.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized depictions of blood and death, mature themes, and non-explicit sexual content. Recommended for a mature audience.
